master: dsfd_sp_vm (composition dsfd_sp_vm_m: dsfd_vm_fe N + 4 x 4 dsfd_vm_bgq28 + dsfd_vm_be S)
rtl: rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_sp_vm.sv (+ dsfd_vm_bgq_sys.sv dsfd_vm_bgq28); gate tools/s81_vm/s81_vm_gate.py; composition physical/s81_ph_views/vm_master/composition.json

outline_um.tiles: 4 columns x 4 tiles of 345.6 x 500.04 at x 0 .. 1,382.4 (N / S pins on M5 + M7)
outline_um.note: fits the ds-1010 hub-column VM slab 1.52 x 2.42 mm (main 6b5bb0506); 16,384 x 512 b (8 Mb, 128 macros) kept; FE / BE span the slab width

clocks.ck: serial 0.9 GHz (VM core, FE, tiles, BE)
clocks.cks: stream 1.2 GHz (dsfd_sp_ctrl side: engine adapter + ctrl VM port CDC)

ports.f_cap [13375:0] in (FE N face, abutting: dsfd_sp_capture t_vm (G3 layout). Bind the generator bus capture->vm at 13,376 b (today 512). Compiler: obase and ops 256-element aligned (RTL alignment fault otherwise).
ports.f_svc[NSVC*1027-1:0] in: per HBM stack st: the ha_<st> r2l end block o (1027) = {fault, live, rows {a1, a0}, v}; generator aSW/aSE/aNW/aNE in stack order. NSVC = 1 (layer1) / 4 (scan die).
ports.t_bl lanes 11 .. 14 out (513 each): q to the scan service st: {row, v} (generator q<st> 513). qSWs (3 in, hq end block status) to be bound to a fault input (VM sends q segments only per the selector rules; overflow is a schedule error).
ports.f_coll [2099:0] in, t_cts [2:0] out: collective t_vm (WIDENED 2,100 per the collective contract) and its ts input (room for >= 8 words on every word lane, live). Generator f_collective 512 -> 2100 + ts.
ports.f_sel [514:0], f_col [514:0] in: selector / collector r2l end block outputs (generator sel / col 515, unchanged).
ports.f_hc [1025:0] in: HC N half results {v1, row1, v0, row0} (generator f_hc 1024 -> 1026: per-row valids; s81-suhc-1011 HC master).
ports.t_bl [16*513-1:0] out: VM -> consumer read-bus lanes {row, v}: 0/1 t_su_s, 2/3 t_su_n, 4/5 t_hc (generator 1024 each -> 1026 with valids), 6 t_gather (512 -> 513), 7..10 t_pq (generator 2162: PQ_VMR layout to be aligned with the pq owner), 11..14 q svc 0..3, 15 eng (engram prefetch consumer, home dies). Rows stream from the X streamers (engine ops XMAP / XGO), valid-only (no back-pressure).
ports.WFC: f_swv/f_swd[526:0], f_srv/f_srd[30:: dsfd_vm_wfc_ep RD2 (9c9ac6963) die side, posted writes; t_ks to capture (WFC kit start). Generator f_wfc 544 / t_wfc 516 predate RD2: re-derive from the ep ports.
ports.ctrl VM port (stream): vwe, vwa[13:0], v: slab_contracts reserved groups ctl_vw / ctl_vr / ctl_vq; dsfd_sp_ctrl runs USE_VM_RVALID 1 (read data with vrv after the CDC; vm_read_cycles is not 1). Controller VM op rate <= 1.5 a stream cycle averaged over 8 entries.
ports.engine channel (stream): cv, cd[83:0] in: ot_s81_engine_adapter inside the FE (QD 8). NEEDS a dsfd_sp_ctrl engine index for the VM (s81-ctl-1011: none of the 12 is the VM; spare is the WFC kit). VM ops arg[23:21]: 1 ARMB, 2 ARMR, 3 ARMN (completion counter), 4 P2ID, 5 P2RD, 6 LARM (landing pointer), 7 XMAP / XGO (streamers).
ports.t_rdy[3:0] out: row-completion counter slot levels = e_inputs_present of the consumer engine adapters (su, hc, fld, coll, ...): the consumer descriptor names the slot.
ports.c_l0v, c_l0d[603:0] out, c_l0r in: P2 lane 0 to the p2 ep (draft die A, --p2-lnk / --coll-p2-lane).
ports.flt, fvec[31:0], max_occ[2:0] out: sticky status to the die status chain.

die_kind_notes: MTP rows-ready and P2 lane exist only on head / draft dies: an RTL parameter will remove them elsewhere (no tied-off functional ports); seedl (draftPs) and eng (home dies) clients follow in v3.1.
port_plan: NP 28 tile ports (dsfd_vm_bgq28): p0/p1 WFC, p2 X2, p3/p4 ctrl A/B, p5 P2, p6/p7 X0/X1, p8/p9 X3/X4, p10/p11 landing drains (svc, coll, sel, col, hc FIFOs 64 rows each, ot_sram_1r1w_64x512), p12..p27 capture lanes
landing_choice: per producer, decided by the worst-burst bench (land_attn: svc 128 + sel 64 + col 680 + coll 320 concurrent, land_hc): every landing producer = FIFO 64 rows into 2 shared drain ports (no-back-pressure lanes first, coll by t_cts); mut_lsmall (16 rows) must overflow. Capture = 16 dedicated lanes (rate 10.7 rows / cycle, no back-pressure).
pin_plans: physical/s81_ph_views/ports/contract_vm28/{dsfd_vm_fe, dsfd_vm_bgq28, dsfd_vm_be}/ (tools/s81_ph/s81_ph_vm_master_tiles.py); slab-level die pins = FE N face + BE S face (+ ck/rst/cks/rss W)
